lyrics: vAlAyamugAnu rAnu rAma jAgEla suguNa shrI dasharatha
nrpAla hrdhayAnandhakara shrI lOla pAla velayu mika
phAla lOchana hrdhayAlaya Aptha janapAla kanakamaya
chEla ika parAkEla ipuDu mammEla nIdu manasEla rAdhu
nIvE gathiyaNTini gAni nEvErEmi Eruganu mundara rAvE nI pAdapankaja
bhakthi nIvE bhAvajAri nuta dEva nIdu padha sEva phalamu mamu gAvunE
pathitha pAvana tridhasha nAthanIya muni jIvanAnishamu brOvavalE shrI rAma
dhArAdhara nibhadEha janAdhAra duritAgha jalada samIra thyAgarAja
hrdayAgAra sArahIna samsAramandu vEsAri ninnu manasAra mammukona
nEralEni ika vicAra manduTaku meragAdu shrI rAma
